title: Require Service Database Import Funnel
forbids: a direct database-source import from a standalone service module, handler, root anchor, model, module middleware, middleware index, or any other source outside the database interior and direct named service-root middleware leaves
why: Database source realizes service-owned stores. Only database internals and direct named service-root middleware leaves need that source in production; modules consume projected capabilities through inherited oRPC context. Owner-local package proof remains governed by the service test boundary.
remediate: Move the database import to a direct named service-root middleware leaf that exports the generic middleware value, import that value by semantic alias in impl.ts, attach it to the service lineage, project a narrow store capability into context, and consume that capability from the module handler. Do not create a root middleware barrel. Keep external database acquisition in its resource/provider owner.
message: Database source may flow only into service-root middleware leaves or other database-owned source.
